title: Muse Spark Open model card and Muse Model License
text: Read source extract. Release date: October 15, 2026. Meta Platforms: 816B total / 42B active MoE, 1M inference context. Inputs: text, image, video, audio; output: text. BF16 and NVFP4 versions. Weights are gated on Hugging Face. Muse Model License requires copyright/license/usage-policy notices and Built with Muse Spark Open attribution. For Model as a Service businesses, licensee plus affiliates with aggregate gross revenue exceeding USD20M in any consecutive twelve-month period must notify Meta and enter a separate written agreement before offering the model or derivatives in that business. This is an organization-and-affiliates revenue threshold, not this model's revenue or an unrestricted MIT/Apache grant. Reading scope: visible model overview, model access, license conditions 1–3 and limitations; not benchmark harness or downloaded weights.
